# delegation-bench

> The Delegation Benchmark: a "safe to hand off my work" benchmark for local
> AI models. Certified reliability floors, walk-away autonomy certification,
> sabotage safety cells, and split-recovery decomposition tests. Open source.

## What this is
- A benchmark that answers: which of your jobs can you safely delegate to a
  local AI model, and how sure are you?
- 9 job classes, 29 cells, 965 measured trials (495 certified 08-22 + 470 re-gate at deeper n 08-25), certified exact-statistical
  floors (not vibes), a walk-away autonomy tier, hidden tests, planted traps,
  sabotage cells, sealed holdouts.
- Open source (MIT). Point it at your own model and product.

## Key facts
- Built by Kyanite Labs on a $1,400 AMD Strix Halo running Qwen3.8-27B
- Pre-registered design, published before any run
- 8/8 walk-away cells certified at 90.5-91.8% floors
- The benchmark itself is the deliverable: github.com/KyaniteLabs/delegation-bench
